params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name of the company. Required if company is not provided.

params.name: company
params.description: Company name. Required if domain is not provided.

params.name: first_name
params.description: First name of the person. Required with last_name if full_name not provided.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Last name of the person. Required with first_name if full_name not provided.

params.name: full_name
params.description: Full name of the person. Required if first_name and last_name not provided.

params.name: linkedin_handle
params.description: LinkedIn profile handle for the person.

params.name: max_duration
params.description: Maximum duration for the request in seconds. Between 3 and 20, default is 10.

items.docs: Finds the most likely email address from a domain name, a first name and a last name. You must provide a domain or company, and a name (first/last or full) or LinkedIn handle.
